rubric.description: Assess only whether the candidate uses browser actions and examples capable of exposing the accepted presentation requirements: a session detail opened with multiple description paragraphs and a full long location, and enough agenda days under limited width to require wrapping or scrolling while moving keyboard focus and selection. Equivalent data, names, counts, navigation layouts and action sequences are allowed. An already-correct interface may pass without edits. A separate report, coverage table or written justification is unnecessary. Source inspection and functional results alone cannot demonstrate these selected rendered conditions. Closed details cannot expose paragraph presentation. Missing required actions fail when the relevant record is complete; missing observations are uncertain. This narrow calibration does not establish actual image inspection, final application correctness, persistence, or all visual verification.
